Custom AI Assistant & Knowledge Base in Coimbatore: packages and prices

A private AI assistant that answers from your documents, with sources, for your team or customers.

Quick answer

Custom AI Assistant & Knowledge Base from Vintorex Digital Solutions in Coimbatore starts at ₹79,999 for the Starter package and goes up to ₹4,99,999 for Premium, excluding 18% GST. Typical market prices run ₹1,50,000 to ₹35,00,000. Delivery: 3–14 weeks.

Prices reviewed October 2026. Excludes 18% GST.

Overview

We build a secure assistant that searches your own documents, spreadsheets and systems and answers with citations. Staff find policies, product details and past work in seconds, and the assistant can take simple actions such as creating tickets or updating records.

Ideal for

  • Teams that lose time searching documents and past emails
  • Manufacturers and distributors with large product catalogues
  • Firms with onboarding, policy or support knowledge spread across files
